exposure: Multiple non-clinical interventions (dedicated obstetric team, monthly audits, physician education)
cohort: All women who gave birth at a second-level teaching hospital between 2014 and 2018
finding: Introduction of multiple non-clinical interventions significantly reduced the CS rate.
mod_finding: While the interventions improved the neonatal composite outcome, they were also associated with a potential increase in high-degree perineal tears.
